scope: Numerical well-mixed verification for stationary isotropic constant-density tracers; not finite-inertia spray validation
initial_distribution: uniform positions and independent normalized velocities N(0,I)
gate_rationale: Original fixed Monte Carlo screens were selected for 131072 particles (4096 expected per bin). The refined count gives 8192 expected per bin; tolerances are unchanged. Numerical screens, not physical measurement uncertainty or the physical 20 percent criterion.
negative_control: Physical-velocity local OU with q(x), without inhomogeneous drift, same particle count and finest timestep; no physical correction or particle resampling
refinement_reason: Job 30272108: all corrected final-state screens passed, but seed 21 initial conditional variance error 0.09974 exceeded fixed 0.09 gate. Double particle count with the same seeds/timesteps/tolerances to reduce sampling error; preserve the original failure and both reports. No resampling or seed replacement.
